<DOCSTRING>
Checks if a word can be placed at the given position in a puzzle.

Args:
    puzzle (list[list[str]]): The puzzle grid.
    word (str): The word to place.
    row (int): The starting row index.
    col (int): The starting column index.
    vertical (bool): Whether to place the word vertically.

Returns:
    bool: True if the word can be placed, False otherwise.
</DOCSTRING>
